title: fix(playwright): browser.start looks up playwright from the consumer cwd and dies before its own error
description:
## .what

`browser.start` fails in a consumer repo that does not itself depend on playwright: it dies at
`browser.start.sh:194` with a bare MalfunctionError, before its own "chromium not found"
ConstraintError at `:200`.

## .repro

- consumer: ehmpathy/rhachet-roles-bhrain, devDependency `rhachet-roles-bhrowser@0.1.0` (pnpm)
- `npx rhachet roles link --repo bhrowser --role playwright`, then
  `rhx browser.start --mode HEADFUL --session skeptic`
- result: `MalfunctionError: command failed · line: 194 · command: CHROMIUM_VERSION=$(get_chromium_version_from_playwright) · exit_code: 1`

## .root cause (read, not guessed)

1. `browser.start.sh:179` runs `npx playwright install chromium --dry-run` from the consumer cwd.
   pnpm keeps `playwright@1.60.0` in the store as bhrowser's own dependency
   (`node_modules/.pnpm/playwright@1.60.0`), but links no `node_modules/.bin/playwright` at the
   consumer root, so npx cannot find the version bhrowser declares. stderr goes to /dev/null, so
   the cause is hidden.
2. under `set -euo pipefail`, the empty output makes `grep -oP` exit 1, which kills the skill inside
   the command substitution at `:194`; the clean ConstraintError and hint at `:200-202` never run.

chromium builds are present in `~/.cache/ms-playwright` (chromium-1155, -1223, -1234); the binary is
not the gap.

## .the shape of the fix

- look up playwright from the package's own install, not the cwd: locate `playwright/cli` with the
  skill's own dir as the root, and call the cli by that path
- let a lookup miss reach the ConstraintError at `:200` (guard the substitution, then test the empty
  value) and print what the playwright cli said
- a clamp: an integration test in a temp consumer with bhrowser installed via pnpm and no root
  playwright; red before, green after

## .why it matters

any pnpm consumer of bhrowser that does not also pin playwright at its root cannot start a browser.
